backup.title: Backup
backup.keyText: With this one key you get everything back from a backup – exchange access included. Without it no backup can be opened. Keep it apart from the server, e.g. in a password manager.

backup.external: Make sure this folder is also backed up outside the server (e.g. NAS backup, backup software or cloud sync).
backup.unmounted: Warning: no folder is mounted at /backups. Backups then live inside the container and are lost when it is created anew (update). Mount a folder of your machine at /backups.

prices.title: Price fetch
prices.text: Price history is extended daily, current prices in an interval. New coins get a suggestion you check on the Prices page.
prices.orderHint: Applies to new suggestions. Confirmed coins stay as they are. The German tax guidance (BMF, Rz. 43) allows prices of trading platforms (examples there: Kraken, Coinbase, Bitpanda) and web lists (examples: CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko). Bitget and Binance are trading platforms, Yahoo is not named – best decided with a tax advisor.

manual.title: Entered by hand
manual.empty: Nothing entered yet. Add a transaction or upload the template.
manual.deleteConfirm: Delete this transaction? It no longer counts; the old version stays in the history.
manual.timeHint: Local time ({{tz}}), seconds optional. Stored in UTC.
manual.templateHint: Download the template, fill it in a spreadsheet, upload it. You see a preview first. Uploading the same file twice adds nothing twice.
manual.exchangeHint: For exchanges without a usable API or export, e.g. because they only go back 180 days. You enter the transactions yourself, one by one or with the template.
manual.deleteBlocked: Deleting is possible once all transactions are deleted.
manual.noSources: Add an exchange or wallet first.
manual.saved: Saved. Edit or delete it via “⋯” in the list.
manual.hideConfirm: Hide this row? It no longer counts, but stays stored and can be shown again.
manual.correctHint: The source's original row stays stored unchanged; your correction counts in its place. A new fetch does not bring the original back.

oneSideHint.transfer: Transfer between own accounts: received = in, spent = out. Enter the other side in the other account/market.
oneSideHint.realized_pnl: Enter either a gain or a loss, not both.
oneSideHint.funding: Enter either received or paid, not both.
oneSideHint.internal_transfer: Either in (from spot) or out (to spot). Enter the other side in the spot market.

manual.whereNow: Add, edit and delete this exchange's transactions on the Transactions page.
manual.transferHint: Saved as a send and linked to the receive there. If the target does not deliver that receive, it is entered there by hand.
manual.resetConfirm: Discard all changes and restore the original data? The changes stay in the history.
manual.feeInBought: Fee in the coin bought: "received" is the amount before the fee. {{arrived}} {{asset}} will arrive. If your receipt shows the amount after the fee, enter received + fee (or leave the fee out).
manual.paidByCardHint: The whole amount came by card from the bank and counts as paid in — even if enough money lay at the exchange. Without it, the app assumes so only when the balance there does not cover it.
manual.transferFromReceiveHint: The receive ({{amount}} {{asset}}) stays as it is. The send is saved at “From” and linked to it right away.
manual.heldPickSource: Pick the exchange or network above to see what was held at that moment.
manual.heldPickFrom: Pick “From” to see what was held at that moment.

prices.subtitle: Where every coin gets its price – check, confirm, correct
prices.reviewHint: Check suggestions: does the curve match what you know? The cross-check compares two sources. Confirm only then.
prices.gap: No price from {{from}} to {{to}}. Transactions in this time stay unvalued – not with 0, but visibly open.
prices.seamHint: Several sources: the price may jump at the seam (one is an index, the other an exchange).

check.ok: Cross-check Yahoo ↔ Bitget, {{days}} days: {{mean}} % apart on average (at most {{max}} %). Unremarkable.
check.deviates: Cross-check Yahoo ↔ Bitget, {{days}} days: {{mean}} % apart on average (at most {{max}} %). Please check – possibly another coin.
check.no_overlap: Cross-check not possible: Yahoo and Bitget share no days.
check.unavailable: Cross-check not possible: one of the two sources does not know the coin.

prices.fetchOneFailed: Fetched, but a source did not answer ({{count}} daily prices new).
prices.name: Full name
prices.sourcesLabel: Sources by rank – per day the top one that delivers counts
prices.tickerHint: Yahoo numbers duplicate symbols: The Graph is GRT6719-USD, Sui SUI20947-USD – search finance.yahoo.com by name. CoinGecko needs the id from the address bar (e.g. vara-network) and only reaches back about a year.
prices.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Yahoo's series ends in 2022, Bitget lists the coin further
prices.sameCoinHint: Some exchanges name the same coin differently, e.g. MEXC “NTGL” and Bitget “NGL” (Entangle). Enter the symbol {{asset}} shall be kept under. The original rows stay unchanged.
prices.sameCoinReason: e.g. MEXC writes NTGL, meaning Entangle (NGL)
prices.iconHint: Symbol name if the icon set calls the coin differently (e.g. RNDR for RENDER). Empty = own symbol.
prices.ended: No current price: the series ends on {{date}} (coin switched or delisted, e.g. FTM → S). Valued until then; afterwards no price is needed as long as you no longer hold it.
prices.worthlessHint: From this day the coin counts as 0. The cost stays, the loss shows. Before it, prices count as usual.
prices.worthlessPlaceholder: e.g. project ended, no longer traded anywhere
prices.untilHint: For a coin that was converted into another (e.g. AGIX → FET). Up to this day prices count as before; after it the app fetches none and removes later ones. Unlike “worthless” the coin is not valued at 0 afterwards, it simply has no price.
prices.untilFrom: Prices end on {{date}}: nothing is fetched after it.

merged.subtitle: A transfer between your sources is one line, spam is hidden

hints.normal: {{transfers}} transfers between your exchanges and wallets are merged ({{rows}} valid rows).
hints.open: Sends and receives without counterpart. Find the counterpart or mark in the ⋯ menu: a send as to others, own wallet or lost; a receive as from an own wallet, bought outside or income.
hints.dust: Tiny receives from strangers (below 0.01 % of your receives of the coin in this source) – mostly dusting. Income never counts as dust.
hints.spam: Hidden: counts nowhere. Whole coins are hidden on the Prices page (“Ignore”).
hints.ambiguous: Sends with several possible counterparts: pick the right one under "Find counterpart".
hints.edited: Lines changed by hand. Reset them under "Details"; earlier versions are in the history.
hints.marked: Sends you marked as "to others" or "own wallet, not set up".
hints.short: Lines after which a coin's balance at its wallet or exchange is below zero: something before is missing (a receive, a buy).
hints.auto: Lines where the app assumed a card deposit, because more money was spent than lay at the exchange.
hints.card: Card purchases where the exchange delivers only the coin, not the euro paid: add it via "Edit" (buy/sell, "paid by card"), else the card fee is missing from the cost.
hints.mcp: Transactions changed through MCP (e.g. by Claude: transfer, note, mark, correction, manual entry …). Each change was confirmed as a list first.

empty.open: Nothing open – every send and receive has its counterpart or an explanation.
empty.card: Every card purchase has its euro amount.

merged.hideAllDustConfirm_one: Hide {{count}} receive? It stays stored and can be brought back.
merged.hideAllDustConfirm_other: Hide {{count}} receives? They stay stored and can be brought back.
merged.splitConfirm: Split this transfer? Both rows show separately again and stay so: the app does not link them on its own again, only you through “Find counterpart”.

badges.shortHint: After this line the balance is below zero: a receive or buy before it is missing.
badges.autoHint: More money was spent here than lay at this exchange. The app assumes the rest came by card from the bank and counts it as a deposit. If a real deposit is missing instead, enter it — then this mark goes.
badges.cardHint: The exchange delivers only the coin, not the amount paid. The app takes the market value; the card fee is then missing from the cost. Add the amount: Edit → Buy/Sell, the euro under "Given", tick "Paid by card".

merged.spamAssetHint: This coin is ignored on the Prices page. It can be undone there.
merged.noCandidates: No matching receive within ±24 hours and ±5 %.
merged.sharp: fits exactly (open only because of a second candidate)

pick.hint: Pick a send and a receive – or a transfer and its fee – or dust suggestions.

merged.noAttachable: No fitting booking of the same source within 2 hours of the transfer.
merged.noTransfers: No transfer of this source nearby (±2 h).

transferForm.hint: Date and time are the send's; the receive moves along. Each changed row is saved as a correction; the original stays in the history, link and fees stay.

merged.hideTransferConfirm: Hide the send and the receive? They no longer count; own entries are deleted. Both stay in the history and can be shown again in the raw data.

marksIn.own_untracked: From an own wallet, not tracked

balances.title: Balance check
balances.manualHint: This exchange has no connection. Enter the current balance per coin; it is compared with your entered transactions.
balances.fetchHint: The balance is taken with the next fetch and compared here with the computed balance.
balances.diffHint: A difference means: transactions are missing in owncryptofolio or in the source, e.g. an older period without a file, unrecorded income or a coin that never appeared in your history.

holdings.unvalued: No price, not in the value: {{assets}}
holdings.unclear: Unclear: {{qty}} more given away than held (≈ {{value}}). See gaps.
holdings.openSent: Sent, open: {{qty}} without counterpart, no longer held.

futures.hint: Valued at the margin coin's daily price on the booking day. Positions without exchange data are grouped by pauses without funding.
futures.openHint: Likely open: the exchange still pays funding but no closing yet. The result is the state so far.

gaps.intro: Transactions are missing here: the holding computed from your transactions runs below zero, or the source's balance differs. Sorted by the missing value. Add the missing transactions (file, by hand) and the gap disappears.
gaps.none: No gaps: every holding is covered and every balance matches.
gaps.negativeText: The holding falls to {{lowest}} {{asset}}, today {{now}}. An inflow (buy, deposit, income) before this day is missing.
gaps.balanceText: Computed {{computed}} {{asset}}, balance {{actual}}. When it is missing cannot be told: the holding never runs below zero.

holdings.allTransactions: All {{asset}} transactions on the transactions page

dashboard.cardHint: of which {{value}} by card (euro without deposit)

notes.title: Notes
notes.none: All covered: no gaps, no open sends, every coin has a price.
notes.unclear: {{value}} were given away without the holding being in the data. These transactions are missing; the result is incomplete.
notes.open: {{value}} were sent without counterpart. Mark them as “to others” or “own wallet” and the portfolio counts them right.
notes.unvalued: No price, not in the value: {{assets}}.
notes.limit_near: {{pot}} {{year}}: {{value}} – {{share}} % of the {{limit}} limit. From the limit on, the whole amount is taxable.
notes.limit_over: {{pot}} {{year}}: {{value}} – the {{limit}} limit is reached, the whole amount is taxable.

dashboard.ticksFilling: The 5-minute history fills from now on. Check back in an hour.

taxSoon.title: Tax-free soon
taxSoon.none: Nothing turns tax-free in the next 30 days.
taxSoon.sum: In the next 30 days coins worth {{value}} turn tax-free

alerts.history_at_risk_one: {{source}}: last successful fetch on {{date}}. The API only reaches back so far: in {{count}} day older transactions are out of its reach.
alerts.history_at_risk_other: {{source}}: last successful fetch on {{date}}. The API only reaches back so far: in {{count}} days older transactions are out of its reach.

tax.note: Evaluation under German law, not tax advice. It counts the single purchases (FIFO/LIFO) per wallet and exchange. The holdings page uses the average price of all purchases instead – so its gain differs from this one.

s20.title: Futures (§ 20 EStG)
s20.hint: Derivatives at foreign exchanges: belong in Anlage KAP, no tax was withheld.

lost.title: Losses from insolvency or fraud
lost.hint: Events: {{count}}. Not netted with gains – the tax adviser decides how they count.

tax.openHint: Open points: {{count}}, items with estimated cost: {{estimated}}. Details in the tab “Open points”.

frozen.title: Version history
frozen.hint: Something affecting this year changed since it was kept – a correction in an earlier year can do that too. Ask the tax adviser whether a correction is needed.
frozen.notePlaceholder: e.g. sent to the tax adviser
frozen.deleteConfirm: Delete this kept version with its PDF and Excel? Your transactions stay untouched.

tax.freezeNoteHint: e.g. sent to the tax adviser

diff.noLines: This version was kept before the history existed: only the key figures compare.

row.nothing: No tax event (e.g. a euro deposit).
row.sold: Sold from these purchases (§ 23, tax year {{year}})
row.incomeHint: At its value on inflow; then a purchase of its own with its own holding period.
row.lostHint: On the loss list, not netted with gains.
row.moved: No tax event – these purchases moved along

forms.title: Filling-in help
forms.noLines: Line numbers change between years: look them up on the form of that year.
forms.hint2024: Line numbers as on the 2024 forms. Check with your tax adviser.

freeCoins.hint: As of today, independent of the selected year: what you could sell tax-free now after holding it for more than a year (§ 23 EStG) and what is still within the holding period. Values at the current price in {{currency}}.

carry.title: Loss carry-forward § 23
carry.none: Nothing to carry for this year.
carry.endAssessed: Carry at year end per assessment
carry.backIn: carried back from the next year
carry.backOut: loss carried back to the previous year
carry.loss: loss of the year, carried forward
carry.hint: The app's proposal: losses go back one year, the rest forward without limit, and only offset gains that reach the limit. The tax office's assessment decides.
carry.hintRunning: Current year: provisional. Losses go back one year, the rest forward; the tax office's assessment decides.
carry.formBefore: Carry from earlier years (as of 31 Dec {{year}})
carry.legend: * current year, provisional · § = assessed figure · Change: + new loss, − offset

returns.title: Returns per month and year
returns.hint: Change in value without deposits and withdrawals, against the value at the start plus what was paid in during the period.

benchmark.title: Comparison: everything in BTC
benchmark.hint: Every deposit buys BTC the same day, every withdrawal sells BTC – what would that be worth today?

fees.title: Fees
fees.hint: Trading, network and futures fees at the day’s value, per year and exchange/wallet. Funding not included (see futures).

health.title: Account health
health.hint: The less shows here, the more reliable holdings, result and tax are. A tap leads to where you fix it.

spot.title: Spot balance
spot.hint: Realized and unrealized with average cost (as the portfolio); single sales and months with FIFO (as the tax).

nodb.title: No connection to the database
nodb.text: owncryptofolio is running but cannot reach its database. Start the PostgreSQL server or its container; this page then opens by itself.

origin.intro: Where the money of a sale, a transfer (own wallets too) or a withdrawal came from: split by origin and as a chain back to the deposits. As a PDF for the bank, notary or exchange.
origin.title: Source of funds
origin.gainUntilTransfer: Price gain up to the transfer
origin.hint: Holdings taken in the tax order ({{method}}). Shares below 1 % are summed up; the Excel file lists every step. “Inflow without recorded purchase” and “Euro without recorded deposit” need their own proof.
origin.lost: Losses through insolvency or fraud ({{assets}}) are not part of the chain.

direct.bank: Paid straight from the bank account

origin.holdingsIntro: Where your holdings of today came from: every coin and the euro on the exchanges, valued at the current price. Above the cost is a price gain not yet sold. A coin shows its chain.
origin.plannedIntro: Planning a withdrawal or a larger transfer and want the proof beforehand? Pick place, coin and quantity: the app shows which holdings the step would take now in your tax order and where their money came from, valued today. Nothing is booked.
origin.lossUntilTransfer: Price loss up to the transfer

summary.swap: On {{day}}, {{qty}} were swapped into {{into}} at {{place}}, worth {{amount}}.
summary.transfer: On {{day}}, {{qty}} were moved from {{place}} to {{to}}, worth {{amount}}.
summary.payment: On {{day}}, {{qty}} were paid to others from {{place}}, worth {{amount}}.
summary.planned: On {{day}}, {{qty}} are to leave {{place}} (planned), worth {{amount}} today.
summary.chain: The chain has {{count}} transactions across {{sources}} exchanges and wallets between {{from}} and {{to}}.

flow.label: Diagram
flow.big: Large diagram with {{count}} steps: scroll inside the box; tap or hover a step for amounts and its links.

beta.badgeTitle: Not yet tested with a real account
beta.title: Not tested yet: {{which}}
beta.intro: The connection to {{name}} ({{which}}) runs through the general exchange interface and has not been checked with a real account. It may work – typical problems seen with the tested exchanges:
beta.introChain: The connection to {{name}} ({{which}}) has not read real transactions yet. It may work – possible problems:

risks.fees: Fees are deducted wrongly or twice (e.g. withdrawals: fee already inside the amount or not).
risks.history: The exchange only answers a limited period; older rows are missing and come from a file import or by hand.
risks.pairs: Some exchanges give trades per trading pair only. The search covers coins you hold today or ever deposited or withdrew – a coin bought and fully sold at the exchange may be missing.
risks.notRead: Not read: futures, margin, earn/staking, transfers between your accounts at the exchange, fiat deposits and direct card or bank purchases.
risks.limits: Fetches may take long or stop because of the exchange's rate limits.
risks.names: Coins may be named differently than elsewhere (renames, tickers).
risks.chain: Incoming, outgoing, fees or tokens may be missing or assigned wrongly.

beta.check: After the first fetch, check the source's balance comparison: if the computed balance differs from the exchange's, something is missing. Fix it with a file import or entries by hand.
beta.tests: This connection is tested with simulated answers only – real use shows whether everything is right. If it works for you, it gets marked as tested.

mapped.title: Own file (CSV/Excel)
mapped.intro: For any exchange: upload its export as CSV or Excel and map the columns yourself. Before importing you see every row as it will be booked. The mapping is kept for the next file of this source.
mapped.look: View the original file (first {{count}} rows, heading marked, mapping above)
mapped.keep: Importing keeps the mapping for this source; the original file is kept.

formHint.movement: Date, type, coin, amount. A buy/sell is either one row with its counter value (e.g. Coinbase) or two rows with the same id (e.g. Kraken): the plus row comes in, the minus row goes out.
formHint.trade: Date, trading pair (or base and quote), buy/sell, amount and price or total.

mapped.tradeNeeds: Needed: trading pair or base + quote, plus price or total.
mapped.noWords: No words found in this column.

problems.unmapped: Value “{{v}}” is not mapped to a type yet
problems.trade_sides: A trade needs exactly one plus and one minus row with the same id
problems.date_format: Date format not recognised – please enter it
problems.counter_missing: Counter value or its currency missing (for a buy/sell in one row)
problems.convert: Swap without a readable note (“{{v}}”) – expected e.g. “Converted 0.1 ETH to 0.003 BTC”

mapped.allRows: No type column – every row is:

mcp.title: Claude (MCP)
mcp.text: Claude Code or Claude Desktop read your data through MCP – holdings, transactions, prices, tax, source of funds, system status – and with tokens of the level “Edit” may also change it after you confirm. Home network only (on the road through VPN). Addresses shortened, keys never handed out, every call logged.

noTokens.mcp: No token yet. Create one per device (e.g. “Claude Code laptop”).
noTokens.api: No token yet. Create one per application (e.g. “Home Assistant”).

mcp.name: Token name
mcp.revokeText: Revoke token “{{name}}”? Claude can no longer get in with it.
mcp.freshHint: Visible only now – copy it right away. Only a fingerprint is stored. The examples below already contain it.
mcp.desktopHint: Add to claude_desktop_config.json (Claude Desktop → Settings → Developer). Needs Node.js on the PC.
mcp.placeholderHint: Replace <TOKEN> with your token – or create a token first, then it is filled in.
mcp.lanHint: The address is the one you are using to open this page. If address or port change, copy the command here again.
mcp.apiText: Your data as plain web addresses – for a phone widget, Home Assistant, a spreadsheet or an automation. Read only. With its own tokens (Claude's do not work here). Home network only, addresses shortened, every call logged.
mcp.apiHint: Every function has its own address under /api/v1/… (e.g. tax_free_soon?days=30, prices?asset=BTC). The first address lists them all with their parameters.
mcp.levelHint: “Edit”: Claude may propose joining transfers, notes, marks, manual entries and corrections – carried out only when you confirm the complete list. Nothing is deleted.

restore.title: Restore
restore.text: Bring a backup back – from the backup folder or as a file from another device.
restore.none: There is no backup in the backup folder.
restore.uploadHint: Choose the …dump.enc file, together with the …keys.enc of the same name if there is one.
restore.keysNo: not included (older backup): if it comes from this installation, exchange access stays readable – otherwise enter it again afterwards
restore.warnTitle: Careful: all current data will be overwritten
restore.warn: Transactions, corrections, settings, exchange access and your password are replaced by the state of the backup. owncryptofolio first makes a backup of the current state automatically – only with it can you go back. Afterwards you sign in again with the password from the backup.
restore.warnSetup: The backup is loaded into this new installation: all transactions, settings, exchange access and your former password. Afterwards you sign in with the password from the backup.
restore.understood: I understand that all current data will be replaced and only comes back through the backup made beforehand.
restore.understoodSetup: I understand and want to load this backup.
restore.running: Restoring … (a few minutes, keep the page open)
restore.done: Restored. The previous state is in the backup folder as {{safety}}. You will sign in again in a moment.
restore.doneNoKeys: Restored. The backup held no keys: if it comes from this installation, exchange access stays readable, otherwise please enter it again. You will sign in again in a moment.
restore.setupText: Choose a backup and enter the recovery key. The old installation shows it under Settings → Backup.
restore.doneSetup: Restored. Now sign in with the password from the backup.

sourceChanges.title_one: One row changed by the source
sourceChanges.text: The source delivered these again with other values (same transaction id and time). Nothing was changed or doubled on its own. If you take the new values, the new row replaces the old one; the old one stays stored.
